title: Dashboard Upgrades
content:
Tasks completed:
- Added router to App.tsx. Installed react-router-dom and then upgraded to a hash router. This solved page history navigation, refresh issues with authFetch, and enabled cross-page linking.
- Completed troubleshooting on the '@' feature and confirmed the ability to link to a manual page within a dev log. Still have not checked if linking to ADR or Spec functions correctly
- Updated default initial view in the Dev Log to show the latest session log saved instead of just the last document created.
- Refactored Dev Journal -> Dev Log to show a runbook (Build) journal type
- Added tabs to the Dev Journal side panel to filter for journal type
- Added text CSS size cycling to the markdown toolbar
- Unified feature sets on the markdown toolbars for the Journal log viewer and the Manual Viewer.
